evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/y/c is @Singleton, owns a CopyOnWriteArrayList of ScheduledMethod plus injected ScheduledExecutorService, computes Duration since last execution against Schedule interval/unit and triggers due tasks.

Due tasks either submit asynchronously through ScheduledExecutorService when the annotation flag is true or invoke synchronously; execution supports an optional Runnable lambda or reflected Method.invoke.
The class preserves the literals 'Scheduled task triggered: {}', 'error invoking scheduled task' and 'error during scheduled task'.
R321 ClientApplicationBootstrap/ClientApplicationModule reference this scheduler, while rs/s/g registers discovered plugin scheduled methods into it.
RuneLite historical net.runelite.client.task.Scheduler contains the same task-trigger log and Schedule/ScheduledMethod architecture.

proposals.note: Source-proven historical Scheduler identity corroborated by exact-v308 lifecycle, logs and application wiring.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/y/a is a runtime-retained method annotation whose members are long interval, ChronoUnit unit and boolean asynchronous flag defaulting false.
The live plugin scan path rs/s/g reads this annotation from methods and builds rs/y/b scheduled-method records that are registered into rs/y/c.
RuneLite historical net.runelite.client.task.Schedule has the same method-targeted runtime annotation shape with interval, ChronoUnit and asynchronous scheduling semantics.

proposals.note: Historical RuneLite source identity is corroborated by exact-v308 structure and live scheduler wiring.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/y/b stores Schedule annotation, reflected Method, target Object, optional Runnable lambda and last-run Instant; construction initializes last to Instant.now().
Its toString bootstrap preserves the exact text 'ScheduledMethod(schedule=..., method=..., object=..., lambda=..., last=...)', directly exposing the historical class noun.
rs/s/g constructs these records for annotated plugin methods and rs/y/c stores and executes them.
The RuneLite task scheduler family uses the same ScheduledMethod record between Schedule and Scheduler.
